description: Upgrade the Cloudflare Worker (cf-flux-schnell) from @cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell to the FLUX.2 family (@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b, flux-2-klein-9b, flux-2-dev). The Worker accepts new optional fields `model`, `width`, `height` while remaining backward-compatible with clients that send only `{prompt, steps}` (defaults: model=flux-2-klein-4b, width=height=1024). Switch the env.AI.run invocation from a plain JSON body to the multipart wrapper required by all FLUX.2 models. Replace the wrangler-template vitest stub with real tests that exercise validation, the multipart construction, and the multi-model dispatch.
steps: In cf-flux-schnell/src/index.ts replace the GenerateImageSchema with a Zod schema that accepts: prompt (string, 1-2048 chars, required), model (z.enum of the three flux-2 model ids, optional, defaults to '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b'), width (z.number().int().min(256).max(2048).multipleOf(32), optional, default 1024), height (same constraints, default 1024), steps (z.number().int().min(1).max(50), optional). Add a per-model config map (MODEL_CONFIG) keyed by model id with {defaultSteps, minSteps, maxSteps}: klein-4b/9b -> {default: 4, min: 1, max: 8}; flux-2-dev -> {default: 25, min: 1, max: 50}. Use a Zod .superRefine() (or .transform after .parse) to clamp/validate steps against the chosen model's range and to fill in the default when steps is omitted.

Replace the Worker's `env.AI.run('@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell', { prompt, steps })` call with the multipart pattern from Cloudflare's official Flux-2 example: build a FormData with prompt, width, height, and steps (as strings); pass it through `new Response(form)` to capture body stream + content-type header; call `env.AI.run(model, { multipart: { body: formStream, contentType } })`. The response shape `{ image: <base64> }` is unchanged, so keep the existing response wrapping (`data:image/png;base64,${response.image}`).

Keep the bearer-token auth (`<redacted-leaked-token>`), the CORS handling, and the existing error classes. Update the response error codes/messages only as needed to surface model/width/height validation failures via the existing ValidationError path.
Update Env interface in src/index.ts: replace `AI: any` with `AI: Ai` (the type comes from @cloudflare/workers-types which is already in tsconfig types).

Switch cf-flux-schnell test infrastructure off @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers and onto plain vitest, because the workers-pool's wrapped AI binding cannot start workerd in this sandbox (verified failure: `workerd/server/workerd-api.c++:837: wrapped binding module can't be resolved ... __WRANGLER_EXTERNAL_AI_WORKER`). Concretely: rewrite cf-flux-schnell/vitest.config.mts to use `defineConfig` from 'vitest/config' with `test: { environment: 'node', include: ['test/**/*.spec.ts'] }` (no pool option, no wrangler reference). The package.json devDependency `@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers` may stay listed (no need to uninstall), but vitest must not load it. Delete cf-flux-schnell/test/tsconfig.json's reliance on cloudflare:test types if it pulls them in.

Replace cf-flux-schnell/test/index.spec.ts entirely with a plain vitest spec. Pattern: import worker from '../src/index'; build a fake env `{ AI: { run: vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({ image: 'AAAA' }) } }`; call `worker.fetch(new Request('https://example.com', {...}), fakeEnv as any, ctx)` where `ctx` is a minimal `{ waitUntil: () => {}, passThroughOnException: () => {} }`. Node 22 provides Request/Response/FormData/ReadableStream globally so no extra polyfills are needed. Cover at minimum: (a) GET returns 405; (b) POST without bearer returns 401; (c) OPTIONS preflight returns 200 with CORS headers; (d) POST with bearer + valid body returns 200 with `image: 'data:image/png;base64,AAAA'` AND the AI.run mock was called with '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b' (the default) and a single options arg whose `multipart.contentType` starts with 'multipart/form-data'; (e) POST with model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-dev' and steps=20 invokes AI.run with that model id; (f) POST with model='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b' and steps=20 returns 400 (steps out of range for klein); (g) POST with width=300 (not a multiple of 32) returns 400; (h) POST with empty prompt returns 400. For the multipart-content assertion in case (d), drain the body stream to a Uint8Array (via `new Response(args.multipart.body).arrayBuffer()`) and decode to text, then assert the form field names ('name="prompt"', 'name="width"', 'name="height"', 'name="steps"') appear in the body — substring checks only, not full multipart parsing.
Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npx vitest run` in cf-flux-schnell/. Both must pass. Iterate until clean.
Document any deviation from the spec (e.g., a test you couldn't write because of vitest-pool-workers limitations) in the findings field.
acceptance_criteria: cf-flux-schnell/src/index.ts no longer references '@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-1-schnell' (grep returns no matches).
The Worker accepts a JSON body of {prompt, model?, width?, height?, steps?} with model defaulting to flux-2-klein-4b and width/height defaulting to 1024.
The Worker invokes env.AI.run with the multipart wrapper { body, contentType } as documented by Cloudflare for the FLUX.2 family.
Per-model steps clamping: dev allows up to 50, klein-4b/9b cap at 8 (request with steps=20 against klein-4b returns 400; same request against flux-2-dev succeeds).
`npx vitest run` passes all new tests, with at least the eight cases listed above.
verification: PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH npx vitest run (in cf-flux-schnell/) — all tests pass
findings:
Implemented FLUX.2 multi-model upgrade in cf-flux-schnell. Source changes: (1) src/index.ts now declares FLUX2_MODELS const tuple + FluxModelId type + DEFAULT_MODEL='@cf/black-forest-labs/flux-2-klein-4b' + MODEL_CONFIG with per-model {defaultSteps,minSteps,maxSteps} (klein-4b/9b: 4/1/8, dev: 25/1/50). (2) GenerateImageSchema rebuilt as z.object({prompt:1-2048, model:enum default klein-4b, width:int 256-2048 multipleOf 32 default 1024, height:same, steps:int 1-50 optional}).superRefine(steps in model range).transform(fill default steps from model config) — width/height/steps defaults are filled by Zod, model defaults to klein-4b. (3) env.AI.run call replaced with multipart pattern: build FormData(prompt,width,height,steps) -> new Response(form) -> pass {multipart:{body:formResp.body, contentType}} to env.AI.run(model, ...). Response shape unchanged (data:image/png;base64,<b64>). (4) Env.AI typed as Ai (from @cloudflare/workers-types). UnauthorizedError, ApiError, ValidationError, MethodNotAllowedError, CORS, and the '<redacted-leaked-token>' bearer all retained. Cast env.AI.run through 'as unknown as ...' because @cloudflare/workers-types' AiModels enum currently lacks the flux-2 ids and lacks the multipart input variant — the cast is the minimal escape hatch and is documented in a comment.

Test infrastructure changes (per FEAT-001 finding that @cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers cannot start workerd in this sandbox even with libatomic, due to the wrapped AI binding's __WRANGLER_EXTERNAL_AI_WORKER resolution failure): vitest.config.mts switched to `defineConfig` from 'vitest/config' with `test:{environment:'node', include:['test/**/*.spec.ts']}` (no pool, no wrangler). test/tsconfig.json's types array dropped '@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers' (kept '@cloudflare/workers-types/experimental'). The devDependency '@cloudflare/vitest-pool-workers' remains listed in package.json but is no longer loaded — left as-is to minimize churn.

test/index.spec.ts entirely rewritten as plain vitest. fakeEnv = {AI:{run:vi.fn().mockResolvedValue({image:'AAAA'})}}; ctx is a minimal {waitUntil(){},passThroughOnException(){}}. Eight cases covered: (a) GET->405, (b) POST without bearer->401, (c) OPTIONS->200 with CORS headers, (d) POST default body->200 with image='data:image/png;base64,AAAA', AI.run called with default model id and an opts.multipart whose contentType starts with 'multipart/form-data' AND whose drained body contains 'name="prompt"', 'name="width"', 'name="height"', 'name="steps"' plus the prompt text and '1024', (e) POST model=flux-2-dev steps=20 dispatches to flux-2-dev and includes '20' in the multipart body, (f) POST model=klein-4b steps=20 -> 400 (out of range; AI.run not called), (g) POST width=300 -> 400, (h) POST prompt='' -> 400. All passed.

Verification (PATH=/opt/toolchains/.nvm/versions/node/v22.22.3/bin:$PATH): `npx tsc --noEmit` exited 0; `npx vitest run` reported 1 file / 8 tests passed in ~24ms (errors logged via console.error from handleError() are expected, they're the validation-failure paths). `grep -RIn 'flux-1-schnell' cf-flux-schnell/src` returned no matches. No deviations from the spec; package.json was not modified.
